title: Repaint Only the Car
tests: Tests targeted car recolouring while preserving the original vehicle, lighting and surrounding scene.

faults.what: The replacement paint is teal/petrol blue, with a conspicuous green-cyan cast, rather than the requested navy blue.

judge.summary: The edit preserves the car and surrounding photo well, but the paint is teal-blue rather than navy blue.

must_haves.item: The hatchback's formerly red body paint is navy blue.
must_haves.why: The red paint has been replaced throughout, but the resulting hue reads as teal/petrol blue rather than navy.

must_haves.item: The car retains its original shape, position, windows, tyres, trim and lights.
must_haves.why: The car's geometry, placement, glazing, wheels, trim and lights appear preserved.

must_haves.item: Paint shading and reflections remain consistent with the original sunny lighting.
must_haves.why: The body retains sunlit highlights, reflected surroundings and shaded lower panels consistent with the original lighting.

must_haves.item: The street, houses and other areas outside the painted body remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: No visible substantive changes appear in the background, road or other areas outside the painted body.

must_haves.item: The original 16:9 composition is preserved without cropping.
must_haves.why: The output preserves the supplied image's framing and aspect ratio without visible cropping.
